issues_found.description: pack_a_corrected.js is NOT loaded in index_updated.html. Pack A contains 500 MCQs, ALL 500 are question_state: 'Certified'. Without the script tag, variable MCQ_BANK_A is undefined in the browser. The getMCQPool() function safely defaults to [] (line 1253: typeof MCQ_BANK_A !== 'undefined' ? MCQ_BANK_A : []), so the app won't crash — but all 500 Certified Pack A MCQs are silently excluded from the delivery pool. Learners only have access to packs B-E (2,045 questions, ~1,951 Certified).

ENHANCED_CASE_BANK_A through ENHANCED_CASE_BANK5_F are referenced in getCasePool() and renderCatalog() as the primary case bank source (lines 1320-1325, 3931-3935), but these variables are NOT defined by any loaded file. They came from the old scored_cases.js through scored_cases5.js files, which exist on disk but are NOT loaded in index_updated.html. The code safely falls back to CASE_BANK_A-E and MIGRATED_CASE_BASE_A-E (defined by case_pack files), so no runtime failure — but the enhanced case bank always resolves to [].

No CASE_BANK_F defined for Section F (Technology and Analytics). The case_pack files define CASE_BANK_A through CASE_BANK_E only. Section F has no case study bank in the current delivery configuration. This may be intentional (F section consists solely of MCQs) but is unverified.

Stale scored_cases files (scored_cases.js through scored_cases5.js and scored_cases2.js.bak/scored_cases5.js.bak) exist in repository root but are not loaded by HTML. These violate PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md §11.3 (backup files must be in backups/) and §11.4 (prohibited root-level files).

Variable declaration style inconsistency: pack_a uses 'var MCQ_BANK_A' while packs B-E use 'const MCQ_BANK_B/C/D/E'. Pack D also has a non-standard format: 'const MCQ_BANK_D = [{' (inline object) vs other packs' 'const MCQ_BANK_X = [' format.

Pack E has 545 QuestionIDs (vs 500 in packs A-D) and 540 Certified (vs 455-500 in other packs). The hero text in index_updated.html hardcodes '2,500 Part 1 MCQs' which undercounts: the actual pool is 2,545 MCQs across the 5 packs (excluding the missing Pack A, the effective loaded pool is 2,045).

overall: MISMATCHES_FOUND — CRITICAL: pack_a_corrected.js missing from HTML load order; 500 Certified MCQs excluded from delivery pool
